RESTART PLAN, revised by Fable2 TermAl #5496/#5498 on 2026-11-11 07:09Z; this supersedes the timing in post-restart-task-2.
- The next restart comes only after w-18a1ae323de4 (Greg's 60 s operation limits, P0, Sol-a7bb) is landed and installed. combo50 and combo51 come with it, plus the Engram sync install if it is installable within about 30 min.
- If w-18a1 slips past about 10:00Z, the restart is for combo50+51 alone.
- DL560 FULL lane: combo50 -> combo51 -> w-18a1 (the moment it is READY, ahead of the others) -> Engram sync 8f55 FULLs (about 09:00Z) -> the rest.
- Evaluation sequence, strictly one at a time, stopping on any timeout: Sol-8e1f's same-key w-6e81 resubmit -> w-638b -> w-5c35 -> w-3075.
- w-5c35 and w-3075 still need their DL560 installs. Do those in the gap between combo50's FULL END and combo51's FULL START.
- The post-restart census check (closingJob about 0, J about 23, 2-3 latency calls) still applies after that restart.
